headline.family_guess: Helvetica Neue / Inter Bold (generic geometric sans)

caption.family_guess: same bold sans as headline, slightly smaller
caption.size_rel: 0.04-0.05 of frame height, white fill + heavy black outline/drop-shadow, always 1-2 lines

layout.host_pos: center-frame, seated cross-legged, chest-up to full-seated framing, static locked camera, sage-green wall + wood shelf behind (red object top-right shelf as recurring color anchor)
layout.safe_zones: captions sit in lower-middle third, never over host's face/hands; top ~10% reserved for occasional chyron/logo card cutaways
layout.caption_pos: lower-center, one caption per beat, burned-in, changes every 1-2s synced to speech

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: 6-9 cuts (talking-head holds ~1-3s between cutaways; cutaways themselves are quick 1-2s inserts)
transitions: hard cut only, no crossfades/wipes seen

themeable: product/illustration cutaway color grade (currently blue-toned medical illustration set)
